## Find anything in three commands

Paths are relative to the skill folder (`.claude/skills/kosif-superpowers/`); `repo` tools run from the repository root.

```bash
python3 scripts/hub.py find "<the task in the user's words>"   # tools + powers + guides, Arabic or English
python3 scripts/hub.py tool <tool-id>                          # commands, requirements, safety, tests
python3 scripts/hub.py doctor                                  # what runs on this machine now
```

Any MCP client can ask the same questions: `python3 scripts/kosif_mcp.py` (read-only stdio server; `python3 scripts/hub.py mcp-config`).
Machine-readable: [manifest.json](../manifest.json) (everything below as JSON) and [data/tools.json](../data/tools.json) (the editable registry).

### Discover and route / اكتشاف القدرات والتوجيه

Know what this session can do and pick the right capability: briefings, catalog search, routers, requirement checks.

| tool | what it does | first command | guide | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ai-tool-discovery` | Ranks KOSIF catalog powers for an Arabic or English task using weighted field matching with corpus-rarity scoring over the local atlas index, and returns IDs, matched terms, claimed status and requirements with runtime_verified=false. | `python3 scripts/ai_tool_discovery.py "تحريك شخصيات فيديو" --top 8` | [taaft-rea-discovery-audit.md](taaft-rea-discovery-audit.md) | tested-here |
| `boot` | Prints a short self-briefing for Claude: machine facts, catalog counts per domain, how many powers have every listed requirement present, and the installs that unlock the most powers. It can also regenerate or check the repo-root CAPABILITIES.md and llms.txt. | `python3 scripts/boot.py` | [README.md](../../../../README.md) | tested-here |
| `capability-atlas` | Searches the 4,751-power KOSIF catalog in Arabic or English, plans a task by picking capability IDs, process skills, routes and local requirement checks, and rebuilds the atlas index and its guide. | `python3 scripts/capability_atlas.py stats --json` | [capability-atlas.md](capability-atlas.md) | tested-here |
| `capability-runtime-router` | Matches an Arabic or English task to 22 executable KOSIF routes and returns, for each one, the runbook command, which binaries are present or missing, the permissions it needs that have not been granted, and a status that never claims execution. | `python3 scripts/capability_runtime_router.py --task "حلل فيديو مرجعي وأنتج مونتاج مشابه بأصولي" --limit 5 --json` | [capability-operating-manual.md](capability-operating-manual.md) | tested-here |
| `hub` | One question in, everything relevant out: the runnable tools for a task (with a copy-paste command and whether this machine has their requirements), the catalog powers, the guides and, for motion work, reference styles. | `python3 scripts/hub.py find "اعمل فيديو موشن عربي متزامن مع صوتي"` | [INDEX.md](INDEX.md) | tested-here |
| `kosif-mcp` | Read-only stdio MCP server that lets any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor …) ask the same questions as hub.py: find, tool cards, doctor, power search and records, families and guides. | `python3 scripts/kosif_mcp.py` | [local-computer.md](guides/local-computer.md) | tested-here |

### Think, ideate and write / التفكير والأفكار والكتابة

Thinking engines, idea generation, sizing estimates and writing-quality checks.

| tool | what it does | first command | guide | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `anchor-gate` | Compares a text before and after a rewrite (English and Arabic) and reports any factual anchor that was dropped or added: quotes, numbers, currencies, dates, months, weekdays, emails, URLs, paths, handles, versions, ratios and must-keep names. It returns PASS or REVIEW_REQUIRED. | `python3 scripts/anchor_gate.py --before proofs/general-writing/pairs/en_before.txt --after proofs/general-writing/pairs/en_after_drift.txt --text` | [humanizer.md](humanizer.md) | tested-here |
| `architecture-sizer` | Computes a deterministic back-of-envelope capacity estimate (average and peak RPS, minimum replicas, logical and replicated storage in bytes and GiB) from caller-supplied traffic and hardware assumptions, using exact decimal arithmetic. | `python3 scripts/architecture_sizer.py --daily-requests 86400 --peak-factor 5 --payload-bytes 1000 --retention-days 7 --replica-rps 100 --target-utilization 0.5 --copies 2` | [community-source-atlas.md](community-source-atlas.md) | tested-here |
| `invention-lab` | Turns one problem statement into a reproducible, ranked JSON list of falsifiable engineering ideas (16 inventive methods × 4 lenses), each with a hypothesis, test, success metric and rejection threshold. | `python3 scripts/invention_lab.py methods` | [creativity.md](creativity.md) | tested-here |
| `tell-scan` | Scans English and Arabic (MSA and Egyptian) prose for stock 'AI-sounding' writing habits and tool leftovers, and reports each hit with its line, strength and an overall verdict (EDIT/REVIEW/LOOK/LEAVE/CLEAN). | `python3 scripts/tell_scan.py ./draft.md` | [humanizer.md](humanizer.md) | tested-here |
| `think` | Turns thinking procedures into checkable text scaffolds. It picks a reasoning level (L0–L6), writes a task contract, ranks 63 mental models, drafts a backcast plan, builds an idea matrix from catalog powers, scores a weighted decision with sensitivity, runs a Monte-Carlo Fermi estimate and flags weak wording in a draft. | `python3 scripts/think.py ladder "design a 30-day plan for a course launch"` | [cognition.md](cognition.md) | tested-here |

### Motion graphics and rendering / الموشن والرندر

Author editable motion graphics (SVG/HTML/Canvas), scaffold real-library projects, render to MP4 and check the delivery.

| tool | what it does | first command | guide | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `aspects` | Stdlib Python module that turns any aspect spec (W:H ratio, WxH pixels, or an English/Arabic platform name such as reel, cinema or مربع) into a label and even pixel dimensions, plus ratio, resolution-string and validity helpers. | `python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts'); import aspects; print(aspects.resolve('2.35:1'))"` | [executable-creative-motion.md](executable-creative-motion.md) | tested-here |
| `creative-reasoning-bridge` | Turns a kosif.audio-cues.v1 JSON (measured onsets plus aligned words from audio_cue_mapper.py) into an editable motion_director storyboard with timed text, draw-on path, character and camera zoom, plus a decision report that scores the doodle, kinetic and cinematic styles. | `python3 scripts/creative_reasoning_bridge.py ./cues.json --style auto --out ./out/scene.json --report ./out/decision.json` | [creative-intelligence-execution.md](creative-intelligence-execution.md) | tested-here |
| `motion-director` | Validates a word-timed JSON scene script (paths, circles, text, characters, actors, morphs, camera) and compiles it into a self-contained seekable SVG/HTML animation, with an optional MP4 render through the bundled render_html.cjs. | `python3 scripts/motion_director.py doctor` | [executable-creative-motion.md](executable-creative-motion.md) | tested-here |
| `motion-engine-js` | A browser-side script (IIFE) that reads scene JSON from <script id=kosif-data> and animates an SVG film deterministically: pen-style stroke draw-on with a moving pen tip, text fades, polygon morphs, a stick character, pivot-rigged actors (walk/run/wave/point/sit), per-scene camera zoom/pan and word-timed RTL captions. It exposes window.__kosif.seek(t) so frames can be rendered exactly. | `python3 scripts/motion_director.py compile ./scene.json --out ./out/film.html` | [executable-creative-motion.md](executable-creative-motion.md) | tested-here |
| `motion-kit-bridge` | Converts motalim-ai/motion-starter-kit word-timing JSON (lines[].words[]) into a validated native KOSIF Motion Director storyboard and optional seekable HTML for the plotter, doodle, whiteboard or infographic styles. | `python3 scripts/motion_kit_bridge.py styles` | [motion-starter-kit-bridge.md](motion-starter-kit-bridge.md) | tested-here |
| `motion-runtime` | Scaffolds an editable Arabic whiteboard-doodle SVG film (film.html + motion.json) with a deterministic seek contract, lists 25 motion-engine route cards, and on explicit --run renders it to a 1080x1920 PNG preview or MP4 via render_html.cjs. | `python3 scripts/motion_runtime.py doctor` | [motion-runtime.md](motion-runtime.md) | tested-here |
| `motion-stack` | Lists 25 catalogued motion engines and writes original, uninstalled starter projects for GSAP (+Rough.js/Vivus), Remotion, Manim, Three.js, PixiJS or p5.js that expose a seekable window.__kosif contract. | `python3 scripts/motion_stack.py list` | [executable-creative-motion.md](executable-creative-motion.md) | tested-here |
| `motion-toolkit` | A dependency-free ES module that exports 12 deterministic animation primitives you can seek to any time: clamp, easing, keyframe interpolation and timelines, SVG stroke reveal, camera pan/zoom, walk-cycle joint angles, parallax, seeded hand-drawn line jitter, SMPTE-style frame timecode, whole-word caption cue state and a render frame-contract check. | `import {ease, interpolate, timeline, strokeReveal, camera, walkRig, parallax, seededSketchLine, timeCode, wordCueState, assertFrameContract, clamp} from "./resources/motion-runtime/motion_toolkit.mjs";` | [motion-runtime.md](motion-runtime.md) | tested-here |
| `render-html` | The skill's bundled copy of KOSIF's deterministic HTML-to-MP4 renderer. It renders a local or http HTML film frame by frame in headless Chromium, either through the page's window.__kosif.seek(t) or under Chromium virtual time for any CSS/WAAPI/rAF page. It encodes H.264 with ffmpeg, optionally muxes untouched audio, and checks fps, frame count, duration, size and audio with ffprobe. --preview makes an 8-frame contact sheet instead. | `node resources/motion-runtime/render_html.cjs --in ./film.html --out ./out/film.mp4 --fps 30 --audio ./voice.wav` | [motion-runtime.md](motion-runtime.md) | tested-elsewhere |
| `verify-video` | Checks a rendered video with ffprobe/ffmpeg against the request (H.264/yuv420p, even size, aspect, fps, duration and frame count, AAC audio, EBU R128 loudness and true peak, master-audio length) and prints PASS/FAIL lines with an optional JSON report. | `python3 scripts/verify_video.py ./in.mp4 --aspect 9:16 --fps 30 --duration 15 --json ./out/report.json` | [verification.md](verification.md) | tested-here |

### Editing and reference video / المونتاج والفيديو المرجعي

Read a reference video, rebuild an editable edit with the user's footage, plan and render cuts, gate quality.

| tool | what it does | first command | guide | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cinematic-broll-render` | Renders a real camera-motion B-roll video master with FFmpeg from a production-ready cinematic_cut_planner EDL and a licensed footage manifest (push-in, pull-back and pan per shot, exact frame counts), stream-copies the original audio and verifies frame count and audio bitstream hash. | `python3 scripts/cinematic_broll_render.py --edl ./edl.json --manifest ./clips.json --audio ./voice.wav --out ./out/master.mkv --width 1080 --height 1920` | [KOSIF_MEDIA_EDITOR_DEEP_RESEARCH_20261019.md](../../../../docs/KOSIF_MEDIA_EDITOR_DEEP_RESEARCH_20261019.md) | tested-here |
| `cinematic-cut-planner` | Builds a deterministic JSON edit decision list (kosif.edl.v1) from word timings and a reviewed, licensed footage manifest: splits scenes at speech pauses or every 7 s, picks the best tag-matching clip per scene, assigns camera moves and lists blockers instead of inventing footage. | `python3 scripts/cinematic_cut_planner.py --words ./words.json --clips ./clips.json --duration 48.5 --fps 30 --out ./out/edl.json` | [REA_FILM_EDIT_CAPABILITY_STUDY_20261019.md](../../../../docs/REA_FILM_EDIT_CAPABILITY_STUDY_20261019.md) | tested-here |
| `motion-reference-probe` | Reads an authorized local video with ffprobe (duration, size, fps, audio presence) and optionally runs ffmpeg scene-change detection, producing a JSON timing report of cut candidates and segments that downstream KOSIF edit tools require. | `python3 scripts/motion_reference_probe.py ./in.mp4` | [executable-creative-motion.md](executable-creative-motion.md) | tested-here |
| `reference-edit-engine` | Turns a motion_reference_probe cut report (plus optional audio cues, visual fingerprint and owned replacement clips) into a new, unrendered, editable Remotion React project with frame-exact shots, word-safe cuts and a quality-gate audit. | `python3 scripts/reference_edit_engine.py --probe ./cuts.json --out ./new-edit` | [reference-edit-execution.md](reference-edit-execution.md) | tested-here |
| `reference-visual-fingerprint` | Decodes an authorized local video at 64x36 and 2 fps with ffmpeg and measures per-shot palette, luma, contrast, saturation, frame change and coarse translation candidates, writing a JSON fingerprint that reference_edit_engine can apply as new shot colors. | `python3 scripts/reference_visual_fingerprint.py ./in.mp4 --probe ./cuts.json --out ./reference-look.json` | [reference-visual-transfer.md](reference-visual-transfer.md) | tested-here |
| `video-workflow-bridge` | Generates deterministic, non-destructive JSON for two editor workflows: a text-based paper edit that turns selected word ranges into frame-bounded video-only segments, and frame-accurate review markers with timecodes and optional pixel anchors. | `python3 scripts/video_workflow_bridge.py paper-edit templates/ik-wave-words.json --keep "1-3,5" --fps 30 --out ./out/paper-edit.json` | [global-video-platforms-2026-10-19.md](global-video-platforms-2026-10-19.md) | tested-here |

### Audio and rhythm / الصوت والإيقاع

Measure real audio: energy cues, timed words, tempo hypotheses, and map them to motion decisions.

| tool | what it does | first command | guide | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `audio-cue-mapper` | Measures a 16-bit PCM WAV (up to 120 s) into a kosif.audio-cues.v1 JSON: a 50 ms RMS energy envelope and rising-energy onset candidates. It can also import existing WhisperX/KOSIF word timings after checking their order and range. It never invents BPM, beats, words or emotion. | `python3 scripts/audio_cue_mapper.py ./voice.wav --out ./out/cues.json` | [creative-intelligence-execution.md](creative-intelligence-execution.md) | tested-here |
| `music-rhythm-engine` | Turns a kosif.audio-cues.v1 file into tempo hypotheses. It scores 60–200 BPM against the measured onset candidates and returns the top three distinct tempos. It adds an estimated beat grid when the best match is at least 0.60, plus per-second energy sections relative to the track median. All results are flagged as unverified. | `python3 scripts/music_rhythm_engine.py ./out/cues.json --out ./out/rhythm.json` | [music-rhythm-execution.md](music-rhythm-execution.md) | tested-here |

### Drawing and characters / الرسم والشخصيات

Code-drawn characters and scenes, painting, IK and full-body animation, sketch assist.

| tool | what it does | first command | guide | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `character-fullbody` | Renders a layered 2D full-body character that walks, runs, waves, smiles, blinks and nods on time or word cues, using two-bone IK for legs and arms. Exports PNG/SVG stills or GIF/H.264 MP4, with optional packet-verified original AAC audio. | `python3 scripts/character_fullbody.py doctor` | [fullbody-character-motion.md](fullbody-character-motion.md) | tested-here |
| `character-ik` | Animates a simple drawn character's arm with analytic two-bone inverse kinematics toward targets cued by time or by verified word timestamps. Exports PNG/SVG stills or GIF/H.264 MP4, optionally with the original AAC narration stream-copied and verified by packet hashes. | `python3 scripts/character_ik.py doctor` | [character-ik-motion.md](character-ik-motion.md) | tested-here |
| `code-drawing-master` | Generates an editable 1080x1920 Motion Director storyboard JSON, plus an optional self-contained seekable HTML preview. The storyboard shows procedural vector human and/or cat characters drawing on in a street or park, with six actions, three moods and optional real word timestamps. | `python3 scripts/code_drawing_master.py --cast human+cat --expression happy --location street --action walk --out ./story.json --html ./story.html` | [code-drawing-master.md](code-drawing-master.md) | tested-here |
| `creative-paint` | Paints a strict JSON layered scene (rectangles, ellipses, lines, polygons, pressure brush strokes, text) with Pillow into PNG/SVG stills, or animates whole layers with keyframes into GIF or H.264 MP4. | `python3 scripts/creative_paint.py doctor` | [creative-paint-runtime.md](creative-paint-runtime.md) | tested-here |
| `smart-draw` | Turns freehand stroke JSON into a layered drawing, optionally snapping each stroke to a rectangle, ellipse or straight line with deterministic geometry. It then reports the recognized shapes or renders the drawing to PNG/SVG. | `python3 scripts/smart_draw.py doctor` | [blender-smartdraw-research-20261019.md](blender-smartdraw-research-20261019.md) | tested-here |
